synth.notes:
Single mirror axis (wall band on 3x3 grid) + holed pieces. A5 cycles axis -> pieces, largest first. A1/A2 move the selected axis or piece one block in x; A3/A4 move a piece in y.
Pieces are blocked by the board edge and by each other, not by the axis: the axis and pieces can share rows (this was the step-71 counterexample).
Every piece block not on axis row a reflects to row 2a-b in both directions. Off-board destinations and destinations covered by any piece are skipped.
The frame is built as a layered composite (wall<target<reflection<piece; holes transparent, selected fill 0, reflection fill 4) and then re-extracted. Wall and piece names rank the 4-connected components of (type colour + all 0 cells). Targets are ranked by visible bbox.
Unconfirmed: piece cycle order after the first A5, and splitting merged pieces while the axis is selected. Passes 30/30 with and without hidden state.
